title: Chapter 1439
text:
The Blessed Race of the World Tree had lost in the secondary dimension battlefield, and the army that was fighting at the front line of the Flickering World also stopped their attacks and temporarily retreated. Compared to the danger of the shallow dimension war, the defense circle of the Flickering World border guards was impregnable.

In this wave of attacks, many shallow dimensions were riddled with holes. Although the enemy was repelled, because the battlefield was in the area controlled by the three Universal Civilizations, the damage was not small. A portion of the territory was destroyed, and the three Universal Civilizations' fleets quickly cleaned up the battlefield and repaired various war facilities.

Han Xiao retracted his divine ability and left a portion of his mechanical army to help clean up the battlefield. He then used his remote projection to meet the leaders of the three Universal Civilizations.

The moment Han Xiao arrived, he heard a wave of flattery.

"Black Star, thank you for your hard work!"

"Fortunately, we defeated the Blessed Race of the World Tree. If the enemy destroyed our territory in the secondary dimension, we would have been in a passive position and would have definitely implicated the frontline of the main universe. It's all thanks to you this time. You've contributed a lot, and we thank you on behalf of the entire galactic society."

"I didn't expect the World Tree to have Transcendent Grade combat strength, but it's still not as good as you. We didn't trust the wrong person."

Han Xiao raised his brows and looked at the three of them. They had friendly smiles on their faces, and their attitudes were even friendlier than before.

"Alright, alright, stop bragging."

Han Xiao did not feel anything.

He knew the three of them too well. They were just afraid of his Transcendent Grade strength, so he was not stingy with his compliments.

Hearing this, the three of them stopped talking. Marbruce asked curiously, "How do you feel after fighting with the World Tree Transcendent? Do you feel any pressure? "

Han Xiao shook his head.

"The World Tree's Transcendent Grade combat strength is called the Tree God. It doesn't seem to be a single life form. It might be an individual created through some kind of fusion. I realized that its combat strength doesn't seem to be at its peak. I guess the Tree God's bad condition is related to the absence of the two sealed Tree Kings …"

He gave a brief explanation of his findings.

"In that case, it was a good move for you to seal the Heart Tree King back then. You had foresight," Louis praised.

Han Xiao waved his hand. "Don't be too happy. Although I can deal with the Tree God, it's very difficult to kill him. His regenerative ability is as amazing as mine, and he can return to the World Tree at any time. He's as agile as me."

"No way, wouldn't that be as disgusting as you … Ahem, I mean troublesome …" Marbruce quickly coughed and changed his words. He almost said what was on his mind.

Han Xiao rolled his eyes at him. He could not be bothered to argue with him.

"In short, the Tree God is not easy to deal with. However, I feel that this ability may not be used casually. There should be a price. Otherwise, they would have used the Tree God to kill everyone more than ten years ago."

The three of them nodded and looked at each other. They seemed to have reached a consensus.

"Black Star, we have an idea, or perhaps a request. We hope that you can temporarily guard the secondary dimension alone."

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. "You mean that other than the fleet, I'm the only high-level combatant guarding the entire shallow layer dimension? No matter how many Beyond Grade As the World Tree sends out, I'll deal with them alone? "

"With your ability, you alone are equivalent to dozens or hundreds of Beyond Grade As. There's no need for the other combatants to stay here. We believe in your ability. You can definitely guard the secondary dimension battlefront alone!"

Marbruce's tone was serious, and his words revealed the meaning of 'we think highly of you'.

Han Xiao curled his lips. "If I didn't know that you guys don't dare to fight among yourselves now, I would have thought that you guys were trying to trick me."

"You must have misunderstood us. We're not that kind of person." The three of them looked helpless.

"I think you guys have a misunderstanding about your image. When did you guys become humans?"

Han Xiao complained, shrugged, and said casually,

He spread his hands and casually said, "Alright, since you guys want me to guard the secondary dimension alone, I'll guard it alone. It's not difficult anyway."

Because the World Tree's main body was rooted in the secondary dimension, this was definitely the main battlefield to resist foreign enemies. Han Xiao had originally planned to wait for the opportunity here.

At this moment, Han Xiao suddenly thought of something. His tone sank slightly as he said seriously, "Speaking of which, the time when the World Tree discovered the expeditionary army outpost is a little coincidental. It happened not long after the Pivotal Snake appeared. I suspect that the two are related."

Hearing this, the three of them perked up.

"What are your guesses? Share them."

"I've told you guys about the ability of the Pivotal Snake. After it reaches adulthood, it can track the location of the World Tree's main body. Therefore, I suspect that there's a two-way connection between the World Tree and it. With the maturity of the World Tree, it might be able to sense the location of the Pivotal Snake in reverse. Therefore, the outpost was exposed."

"Then what do you plan to do?" The three of them were slightly shocked.

"Since I'm guarding the secondary dimension, I can protect the key trump card, the Pivotal Snake, and bring it with me. No matter how the World Tree attacks, it will have to pass through me first."

Han Xiao paused for a moment before continuing.

"As for how to prove this, it will depend on what the World Tree does in the future. If they have information on the Pivotal Snake, then they will know that they are in a passive position. They will definitely increase their attacks like crazy, not caring about the losses, just to race for time … There is no need for them to do this just because I've revealed my Transcendent strength. Therefore, once the World Tree shows such signs, it means that my guess is almost correct."

"Reliable. Since you have a plan, let's do as you say."

The three of them relaxed and expressed their trust.

After discussing the follow-up plan for a while, Han Xiao deactivated the projection and returned to the room.

He first went to check on the condition of the Pivotal Snake. The Pivotal Snake was not involved in the battle and was still the same as before, ignoring him.

As for the Realmless King, who had already changed from a garbage station manager to a breeder, his attitude was even more respectful, indicating that he would definitely play with the snake seriously.

Leaving behind more Mechanical Oracles to protect the Pivotal Snake, Han Xiao changed into the King and teleported back to the main universe, arriving at the Siebert Fortress at the border of the Flickering World.

He found a group of mascots with ease, and without saying a word, he started a combo of Coiling Dragon Touching Ding without any explanation.

After rubbing off enough luck, Han Xiao closed the door and opened the interface to settle the Tree God's Challenge Mission. 877 Good Book Network

The mission format was the same as the Beyond Grade A Challenge Mission. The duration was the evaluation standard, but the rewards were many times higher.

After the two of them fought for a long time, they had already unlocked all the rewards. The accumulated experience had already replaced [The End of Darkness] as the mission with the highest experience he had ever seen. It was a total of 24000 Megabytes, more than double. In other words, it was equivalent to more than twenty old Manymen.

The other rewards were also refreshed.

You have received [Character Summon Card — Tree God (Incomplete)]!

Character Summon Card — Tree God (Incomplete): [World Tree Devour] — Devours external matter or energy and converts it into the power of the World Tree to replenish its own consumption. You can also summon the roots of the World Tree at will. Usage Limit: 0/4

"Recovery ability? Average … However, I used this Character Summon Card. Am I devouring things myself or helping the World Tree devour things?"

Han Xiao scratched his head.

When he was fighting with the Tree God, if he used this move to summon the roots of the World Tree, would the roots listen to him or the other side?

Furthermore, if the World Tree saw that he could also summon the roots of the World Tree, would it think that he was its half-brother?

You have received: Draw one of the Tree God's abilities (Talent).

Upgrade: The Tree God is a special life form. Some of the available abilities have been adjusted.

Randomizing … Randomizing complete!

Please choose one of the following five abilities as the reward:

1. [Tree King Crown — Liberation] — Ability: Fusing with the Tree King Crown will allow you to summon the Tree God. When you further liberate the power of a certain Tree King Crown, the energy level of the Tree God will continue to increase. The price is that the Tree King Crown will be destroyed.

3. [Mental Network — World Tree] — Ability: Enter the symbiotic mental network of the World Tree and communicate with any World Tree life form without distance or delay.

4. [Internal Space Strengthening] — Talent: Your Internal Space Domain is more sturdy and difficult to break.

5. [Information Form Obliteration] — Talent: You can ignore the limitations of space and chain damage the other party's Information Form foundation, causing damage. At the same time … individual memories, network data, written records, and other types of information carriers will also be affected.

"Hiss …"

Han Xiao took a deep breath, and his heart trembled.

"As expected, the Transcendent Grade has the ability to kill Information Forms. It can target those of the same level."

He browsed through it a few times and roughly understood the mechanism of [Information Form Obliteration]. To put it simply, it was to eliminate all traces of the other party's existence in the world. Not only would everyone forget about him, but even the network data and written records would disappear. It was specially used to counter [Information Uniqueness — Conceptual Immortality]. It was quite similar to the Information Form of some of Destiny's Child's Information Form bodies. It could not be observed or transmitted.

As for the abilities of the World Tree Revival and the Underworld Hero Spirit, there was a high chance that they would be directly broken, and those who were hit would die completely … As for the special Sanctum Revival, he did not know if it would be affected.

However, this talent was not casually used. It needed to be judged, and one of the most important factors was the target's state … Even if the difference in strength was huge, as long as the target had the ability to resist, [Information Form Obliteration] would not be effective.

The simplest trigger condition was that the target was in a state with the concept of 'death', such as being on the verge of death or just dying, or being directly killed by the user. This would trigger the effect.

Han Xiao also understood that this was the reason why the Secret Tree King did not dare to self-destruct. Self-destructing in front of him was equivalent to giving up resistance and exposing his belly. It was just that this guy did not expect that he had not grasped this ability before.

"I didn't know this move, but you guys personally sent this ability to me. Thank you."

Han Xiao laughed.

After thinking for a while, he finally made up his mind to choose [Information Form Obliteration].

Perhaps he would be able to unlock this move after reaching the Transcendent Grade, but he had no clue at the moment. Who knew what conditions he would need to comprehend it?

Han Xiao had always believed that benefits were only meaningful, and this ability was the trump card that he urgently needed in the current battle. It was most suitable for the current situation.

Furthermore, he had a hidden worry.

In his previous life, when he blew up the World Tree's main body, Han Xiao had always thought that the three Universal Civilizations had won. However, now that he saw that the Tree God had [Information Uniqueness — Conceptual Immortality], would it also work on the World Tree's main body?

Then, was the victory of the three Universal Civilizations in his previous life permanent or temporary peace? Was the World Tree really gone, or had it been reborn somewhere?

Even if the possibility of such a guess was not high, Han Xiao still felt that he needed to get the [Information Form Obliteration] as soon as possible as insurance. It was better to be safe than sorry.

You have obtained a new talent (Information Form Obliteration)!

The next moment, a mysterious feeling welled up in his heart. Han Xiaoxin sensed it and turned his head to look at the metal table beside him.

His vision changed. He seemed to be able to see fine threads extending from the table, penetrating the wall and stretching into the endless distance. Following these threads, he seemed to be able to see all the information carriers related to the table. He seemed to be able to see the source of the table's material, where it was processed, where it was assembled, how it was transported here, and how many people had come in contact with it …

However, when he wanted to take a closer look, these images disappeared, as if they were just an illusion.

"… Interesting."

Han Xiao looked around the room. Many threads extended from the objects, representing their connection to various information carriers. He had a feeling that he could cut these threads.

"I can only see the connection, but I can't see the specific situation … If this ability is improved further, wouldn't I know everything? Could this be the development path of the Transcendent Grade? "

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

Suddenly, he had an idea. He opened the interface, wanting to see the information connection on the interface, but there were only two threads. One was connected to him, and the other extended out infinitely. He did not know what it was connected to.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and suddenly had a bold idea.

"What will happen if I cut this … Forget it, let's not cause trouble for now."
